rounds.text: Challani Capital Ltd is currently undergoing a significant operational transformation that is being overlooked by the market’s focus on trailing twelve-month volatility. The company has demonstrated a powerful ability to generate high-quality earnings, evidenced by a cash conversion ratio of 1.07x, meaning reported profits are fully backed by actual cash flow [E30]. This efficiency is further supported by a dramatic improvement in working capital requirements, which have been slashed from 184 days to 81.1 days [E43]. While the stock has suffered from recent negative growth metrics, the underlying business is showing signs of a sharp turnaround, highlighted by a 200% year-over-year increase in net profit and accelerating earnings growth [E45, E47]. The company’s commitment to a lean balance sheet is clear, as it is almost debt-free [E42]. Conceded: the trailing twelve-month sales and profit growth are negative at -39% and -69% respectively [E17, E21], and the current valuation metrics like P/E and EV/EBITDA sit well above sector benchmarks [E6, E11]. However, with promoters maintaining a high 74.99% stake and the financial services sector providing a supportive macro tailwind, the current price may be failing to account for the company's recent fundamental acceleration [E34, E48, E49].
